objective: Complete the comparison after the fixed A2 M_B branch repeated a cross-page card path on three fresh attempts. Keep the successful M_H branch and replace M_B with four fixed contiguous term cells.

date_window.pilot_ledger_scope: complete source-year card paths; exact-day disposition is diagnostic and does not remove a raw identity from wildcard comparison

controls.field: raw Keywords over title, abstract, and body text

current_compound_blocks.G_model: G_model_fixed OR G_mission_exact OR (G_mission AND M_B)
current_compound_blocks.G_structure: G_structure_fixed OR G_product_exact OR G_variation OR (G_product AND M_B)

wildcard_candidate.acceptance_rule: Adopt the candidate in every partition only if each two-pass wildcard ledger contains every corresponding two-pass literal stable card path and every wildcard-only path remains within the intended population meaning. Prefer exact equality.
wildcard_candidate.preference_rule: Prefer the shorter wildcard rendering after the acceptance rule passes.

acceptance_checks: Every event has exact source query, years, language, sort, total, and page readback.
Every event completes two full card-path passes from page one.
Every event saves a configured Advanced Search PNG and hydrated first-results PNG beside its JSON.
Every wildcard partition retains every literal stable card path.
Every wildcard-only path is inspected against the population meaning.
No type, access, taxonomy, vocabulary, proximity, pair, or result-driven restriction is used.

adapter_smoke.purpose: prove the CLI has no screenshot opt-out and publishes both sibling PNGs
